locations.title: Locations
locations.intro: Locations are names for folders on this PC (e.g. claude → C:\Users\you\.claude). Rules use these names, so shared rules work on every computer once each one sets its own folders.
locations.remove_desc: Only the alias is removed. No files are deleted.
locations.remove_used: {count} rule destination(s) use this location and will be skipped on this PC until it is set again. No files are deleted.
locations.unmapped_title: Locations used by rules but not set on this PC
locations.unmapped_desc: Choose a folder for each one to start syncing those destinations here.
locations.recognizers_desc: recognizers.json describes skills, MCP configs, instruction files and known tool folders. AgentSync uses it to suggest paths. Edit it to teach AgentSync about new tools.

form.alias_hint: Short ID that rules use to refer to this folder (not a file name). It is suggested from the folder; use the same alias on every PC.

validation.alias_reserved: "home" is built in and always points to your user folder.
validation.alias_invalid: Use up to 40 lowercase letters, numbers, - or _.
